coaching.headline: Kira carried a game the map kept giving back: 12 kills, one death, a 5-1 closing fight seven items down.
coaching.team: We won this on one lane. Kira took first blood on Eden at 7.3 and never lost the carry lane; the rest of the map leaked. Iggy & Scorch and Phase died 0-2 in their jungle at 10.4 with nothing up, a bad trade. Scarlett was caught alone three times between 13.1 and 20.7, Iggy & Scorch twice, and two of those deaths came right before an outer tower fell. We took all three Fangtooths and the Genesis Core at 28, and still cashed one of four won fights. Greystone's solo death to Wukong at 29 gave them Orb Prime at 29.5. Then Kira won the fight at 30.5, 5-1 at our inner tower, seven items down on the count, 12 to 19, and the game ended. Towers finished 5-5 and they out-damaged our structures, 46,986 to 34,393. Next game: nobody walks alone after minute 12; six deaths caught alone was the whole leak.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: Kira's lane, and the objectives it paid for: three Fangtooths and a Genesis Core to their one Orb Prime. The fight at 30.5, won 5-1 with Kira taking four of the kills seven items down, ended it before the Orb Prime could matter.
coaching.whatWorked: Kira on Eden: first blood at 7.3 and five kills on their carry in total, then the fight at 30.5 won 5-1 with four of the kills hers.

The one death was in the bad trade at 10.4 with Iggy & Scorch, nothing up. Kira's one death came at 14.3 with Scarlett at our Fangtooth, traded for the Fangtooth in the same window; Phase has no kill or death credited there, which proves nothing about presence. Nothing to fix here.

ability.name: Purge
ability.what: Unleash a torrent of arrows and bullets for 2.5s, dealing 225/330/435 (+460%) physical damage to all nearby Enemies over the duration and reducing their healing by 45% for 2s.

loadout.plain: Purge heals you for 25% of its damage to heroes. Since you are slowed and cannot attack during Purge, this keeps you alive while you channel into a group.

loadout.name: Marrow
loadout.text: Heal for 6%/7%/8%/9% of damage dealt to Heroes, increased up to 15%/20%/25%/30% based on your Missing Health. (65% effectiveness for AoE attacks, 15% against monsters.)
loadout.plain: Heals you for part of your damage to heroes, more the lower your health. Mercy shots and Purge both deal heavy damage, so it keeps you dueling when low.

loadout.name: Blood Bank
loadout.text: Store 100% of Hero damage as charges for 3s. Gain 0.75% Lifesteal per 100 charges.
loadout.plain: Recent hero damage turns into extra lifesteal. A Mercy plus Dusk burst makes your following basic attacks heal more.

loadout.name: The Maw
loadout.text: Basic Attacks deal 10% bonus True Damage to targets below 40% Max Health.
loadout.plain: Basic attacks deal extra true damage to targets below 40% health. It helps finish targets after Dusk detonates your Vengeance stacks.

loadout.name: Pacifier
loadout.text: Adrenalize:  Dash a short distance. Empower your next Physical Damage Instance within 3s. Deals 30 (+25%) Damage. Increased by 2.5x against Targets below 20% Max Health. Killing a Hero within 3s allows Adrenalize to be recast for 6s.
loadout.plain: A short dash that empowers your next physical hit, much stronger below 20% health. Dash, then Mercy or a basic to execute, and a kill lets you recast it.

ability.name: Stone Forged Soul
ability.what: Greystone enters Stasis for 2.5s, restoring 14/16/18% (+2.5%) of his maximum health (increased by up to 2.5x based on missing health) and Slowing nearby Enemies by up to 70%, based on proximity.

lines: Lead story: Soaked the fights. 2,213 damage mitigated a minute, more than 91% of Greystone offlane players this patch.
Stone Forged Soul at rank 3: 145s base, about 131.8s by the end (9% shorter) from 10 ability haste: Catalytic Drive 10.
6 takedowns (4 kills, 2 assists) fed: Cannibalism (minor).
Their build heals off damage: anti-heal (the Tainted items) cuts it.
Greystone dealt 30,534 hero damage, 29% of their team's, with +50 physical power from items.

Cursed Scroll (item): On Basic Attack: Deal 20 (+3.5%) Damage to yourself and the Enemy Target. This damage cannot hurt you below 35% Health.

Saphir's Mantle (crest): Increase your Size and Max Health by 10% for 6s. Deal 60 (+1.25%) Damage to nearby Heroes. After the duration, permanently increase your Max Health by 20% of the Damage dealt.

Toughness: +1405 health, +48 physical armor, +75 magical armor; took 61,952 damage, mitigated 68,618, died 1 times.

(game text: Killing an Enemy Unit restores 0.75% of your Maximum Health and grants 2 Gold.) Field: 54.7% in 2020 games, 47% of picks, above the hero-role's 51.9%.

(game text: Atlas:  Increase your Size and Max Health by 10% for 6s. Deal 60 (+1.25%) Damage to nearby Heroes. After the duration, permanently increase your Max Health by 20% of the Damage dealt.) Field: 53.4% in 3229 games, 30% of picks, above the hero-role's 51.9%.
Stack (Every basic attack set off): 4 effects on one trigger: Overlord, Catalytic Drive, Rapture, Cursed Scroll.
Stack (Finishing damage on low-health targets): 2 effects on one trigger: Aegis Of Agawar, Cursed Scroll. Once a fight started going their way, these finished it.

Countered? 1 of the 3 players Greystone killed built physical armor (Aurora). Anti-heal on Gideon, Morigesh, Aurora. We killed Greystone 1 time.
Copy it? Krix (Voracity + Cannibalism): 56.7% in 1,151 Greystone offlane games, above the hero's 51.9%. Proven this patch: worth copying.
